title: Voice note and a typed follow-up
proves: Voice and text are combined in one case: a voice note about threats to a family member and a typed message about the family's fear.
summary: Through the mobile app, a person sends a voice note saying her brother is being warned not to give a statement, then types that the whole family is frightened and the children have not left the house for a week.

steps.text: वो लोग मेरे भाई को धमका रहे हैं कि अगर हमने बयान दिया तो अंजाम अच्छा नहीं होगा।
steps.gloss: They are threatening my brother that if we give a statement, the consequences will not be good.

steps.text: हम सब बहुत डरे हुए हैं। पिछले एक हफ़्ते से बच्चे घर से बाहर नहीं निकले।
steps.gloss: We are all very frightened. For the past week the children have not stepped out of the house.
